test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In which of the following states is the Thervoy Kandigai-Kannankottai reservoir situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thervoy Kandigai-Kannankottai** reservoir is situated in** Tamil Nadu.**
 
• Thervoy Kandigai reservoir is the fifth major reservoir built to satisfy the drinking water needs of Chennai city.
 
• The reservoir was constructed by combining Thervoy Kandigai and Kannankottai lakes in the Thiruvallur district.
 
• It was commissioned** by Amit Shah, **Internal Affairs minister of India, **on November 21, 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Tamil Nadu is famed for its Dravidian-style Hindu temples.
 
• On Pamban Island, Ramanathaswamy Temple is a pilgrimage site.
 
• **Tamil Nadu:**
 
 
• Governor: R. N. Ravi (Sept 2022)
 
• Capital: Chennai
 
• Chief minister: M. K. Stalin 
 
• Population: 6.79 crores (2012)
 
• Language: Tamil
